data.title: Multilingual Chatbot Scam Pattern Detection
data.description: Detect messaging patterns consistent with AI chatbot-initiated scam contact: (1) unusually consistent response timing with less than 2 second variance indicating automated replies, (2) scripted conversation progression matching known romance scam, investment scam, or pig-butchering templates, (3) language switching mid-conversation to target victims in their native language, (4) identical or near-identical phrasing across multiple reported conversation instances. These patterns are characteristic of scam compound operations using multilingual AI chatbots to scale social engineering.

detection.condition: selection_timing and (selection_template or selection_language_switch or selection_duplicate_phrasing)

enrichment_required.source: NLP enrichment (conversation template matching against known scam scripts)
Cross-instance analytics enrichment (phrase similarity scoring across reports)

falsepositives: Legitimate customer service chatbots with scripted responses
